checks.title: Set up naming and PostScript names
checks.info: Family and style names live in Font Info. Style names use plain title case (Bold Italic, not bold-italic). PostScript names contain no spaces or special characters, and family + style should stay well under 63 characters. The naming guide explains how every name type should be written.

checks.title: Set up style linking
checks.info: In Font Info > Exports, Bold, Italic and Bold Italic styles should be style-linked to their base style. Other styles stay unlinked unless you have a reason. Whether linking behaves in real apps is a separate check under Final QA.

checks.title: Master locations are correctly defined in the designspace
checks.info: Check Font Info > Masters: each master's axis coordinates should sit where you intend them, and all instances should fall inside the range the masters span.

checks.title: Default master matches the intended style
checks.info: The default (origin) of a variable font is what apps show before any axis is touched. Make sure it is the style you want as the default, e.g. via the Variable Font Origin custom parameter.

checks.title: Add 'Use Typo Metrics'
checks.info: Add the Use Typo Metrics custom parameter in Font Info > Font (fsSelection bit 7). Apps then use typo metrics instead of win metrics for line spacing — recommended, and required by Google Fonts.

checks.title: Version number and font info are complete
checks.info: Verifies that the version number is sane and that designer, manufacturer and license fields are filled in. Whether the contents are correct stays your call.

checks.title: PostScript names are within length limits
checks.info: The PostScript font name (family + style) must stay at or under 63 characters; some older environments prefer under 31. The checker measures every exporting instance.

checks.title: Weight and width names match weight and width classes
checks.info: Compares each instance's style name against its weight class and width class values — e.g. an instance called Light should carry weight class 300.

checks.title: Variable font names do not conflict with static fonts
checks.info: If statics and a variable font ship from the same file, the variable font needs its own family name (Variable Font Family Name custom parameter), otherwise installations collide.

checks.title: Vendor ID is set
checks.info: Checks that the vendorID custom parameter exists and is exactly 4 ASCII characters. Whether it is your registered ID is up to you.

checks.title: Copyright years and ownership are correct
checks.info: Check the copyright string in Font Info: right years, right owner, consistent with the license text.

checks.title: PANOSE values are intentional or safely neutral
checks.info: Unset PANOSE defaults to all zeros ('any'), which is safe. If you set values, make sure the classification is deliberate, not leftover from another project.

checks.title: Glyphs have their expected Unicode values
checks.info: Compares each exporting glyph against the Unicode value Glyphs expects for that name. A missing codepoint means the character can't be typed or copied from the font.

checks.title: No duplicate Unicode values
checks.info: Two glyphs claiming the same codepoint silently break the cmap table — only one of them ends up reachable.

checks.title: Vertical metrics follow the Google Fonts strategy (if preferred)
checks.info: Google Fonts expects a specific relationship between typo, hhea and win metrics, including a typo line gap of 0. The GF metrics guide explains the strategy; Fontspector verifies it on the compiled binary.

checks.title: Uppercase diacritics remain below the clipping boundary
checks.info: Measures the tallest glyphs (uppercase diacritics in particular) in every master against the clipping boundary (win metrics, or typo metrics when Use Typo Metrics is set) and reports anything that would clip.

checks.title: Vertical metrics are identical across all masters
checks.info: All masters must share the same vertical metric values, otherwise line spacing shifts between styles of the family.

checks.title: Line-spacing is consistent across family styles
checks.info: Compares vertical metrics across all currently open fonts — useful for roman vs. italic files of the same family. Open the whole family before running it.

checks.title: Shapes correspond to alignment zones
checks.info: Overshoots of round shapes should land inside the zones defined in Font Info > Masters, flats on the flat edge. Zones that don't catch your shapes are worse than no zones. This stays a manual read: on real fonts, near-misses are as often deliberate as accidental.

checks.title: Stem thickness is consistent
checks.info: Vertical stems should be consistent with each other, and likewise horizontals. The Stem Thickness plugin (Plugin Manager) measures stems live under your cursor — judge the numbers yourself.

checks.title: No almost-straight segments
checks.info: Curve segments that are nearly but not exactly straight are usually drawing mistakes. Red Arrow (Plugin Manager) flags them directly in the edit view.

checks.title: No kinks in outlines
checks.info: Kinks appear at smooth connections when interpolation bends them. Run Kink Finder from the mekkablue scripts collection.

checks.title: Points are placed at extrema
checks.info: Missing extremes hurt rendering, hinting and interpolation. Red Arrow (Plugin Manager) flags missing extrema in the edit view.

checks.title: No zero handles
checks.info: Fully retracted handles break rendering and interpolation. Red Arrow (Plugin Manager) flags them in the edit view.

checks.title: Terminals are consistent
checks.info: Compare stroke endings across the font: angle, weight and shape should follow one logic.

checks.title: Diagonals are consistent
checks.info: Diagonal strokes (v, w, x, y, k…) should share weight and angle logic across the font.

checks.title: Contour directions are correct
checks.info: Outer contours and counters must run in the correct directions. Mostly matters for variable fonts — static exports fix direction automatically when overlaps are removed.

checks.title: .notdef is drawn
checks.info: Glyphs generates a fallback .notdef at export if you don't have one — this check is for drawing a custom one that matches your design. Verifies the glyph exists and has outlines in every master.

checks.title: Space has an appropriate width
checks.info: Test the space in running text at several weights — it should hold words apart without opening holes. Don't forget the no-break space matches it.

checks.title: Relevant space characters are added
checks.info: Figure space, thin space, hair space, no-break space etc. The Build Space Glyphs script from the mekkablue collection adds them with correct, metrics-keyed widths.

checks.title: No empty exporting glyphs
checks.info: Finds glyphs set to export that have no paths, no components and no width. Almost always an accident — either draw them, give them a width, or switch off export.

checks.title: Brace layers sit inside the designspace
checks.info: A brace layer whose coordinates fall outside the range the masters span never activates — it silently does nothing at export.

checks.title: No nested or flipped components
checks.info: Nested components (components of components) and flipped components can misbehave in interpolation and export. Component Problem Finder from the mekkablue scripts collection reports them, and more.

checks.title: Diacritics align in base shapes
checks.info: Check that marks sit visually centered and consistent over their bases across the alphabet — best judged in a text tab with a stress-test string across all masters.

checks.title: Anchors are consistent
checks.info: Checks that base glyphs and marks carry the anchors Glyphs expects (top, bottom, _top…), so composites auto-align and mark features work.

checks.title: Ligature carets are set up
checks.info: Ligatures need caret anchors (caret_1, caret_2…) so text editors can place the cursor between the components. The checker verifies every exporting ligature has them.

checks.title: Metrics keys are in sync
checks.info: Reports every layer whose sidebearings no longer match their metrics keys — the ones Glyphs shows in red in the info box.

checks.title: No characters are touching
checks.info: Touché scans the font for glyph pairs that touch or overlap and lists them in a tab.

checks.title: Brace and bracket layers are checked for kerning
checks.info: Alternate layers change shapes — kerning that works for the default outlines may collide on brace/bracket layers. Check the affected glyphs at their switch points.

checks.title: No tiny kerning pairs
checks.info: Pairs under roughly 5 units add file size without visible effect — consider deleting them. The mekkablue scripts collection has kerning cleanup scripts for exactly this.

checks.title: No overkerns
checks.info: Run 'New Tab with Overkerned Pairs' from the mekkablue scripts collection to list pairs that kern more than a set percentage of the glyph widths.

checks.title: Consider if extension kerning is relevant
checks.info: Consider kerning beyond the core alphabet: punctuation, figures, brackets and other extensions of your kerning classes.

checks.title: Stylistic sets are named
checks.info: Every ssXX feature should carry a human-readable name — apps show it in their stylistic set UI.

checks.title: Stylistic sets cover diacritics and related glyphs
checks.info: Report-style checker: for each glyph with an .ssXX variant, it lists related glyphs (diacritics, composites) that lack the same variant. You judge what is intentional.

checks.title: Small caps cover all uppercase
checks.info: If the font has small caps, every uppercase (and relevant lowercase) character should have a small cap counterpart.

checks.title: All tabular glyphs share the same width
checks.info: Every tabular glyph (.tf, .tosf) must have an identical width, checked per master.

checks.title: Math symbols are tabular
checks.info: Plus, minus, equals, multiply etc. should share the tabular width so they align in columns of figures. Tabular Checker (mekkablue > Spacing) reports every glyph whose width differs from the tabular width.

checks.title: Fractions use suitable numerator, denominator and slash placement
checks.info: Check that numerators, denominators and the fraction slash align and space correctly, both in precomposed fractions and via the frac feature.

checks.title: Feature code compiles without errors
checks.info: Compiles the OpenType features and reports any errors in features, prefixes or classes — hand-written code can break long before you notice it at export.

checks.title: Intended language coverage is actually covered
checks.info: Hyperglot checks which languages your character set actually supports — intent and reality often differ.

checks.title: Style linking works in different apps
checks.info: Install a test export and verify the Bold/Italic buttons in Word, the style menus in Adobe apps, and macOS font pickers behave as intended.

checks.title: Real exports are tested in InDesign and a browser
checks.info: Actually export OTF/TTF/variable and open them in InDesign and a browser. This catches the class of bugs no source-level check can see.

checks.title: WOFF files are tested in relevant browsers
checks.info: Test the webfont exports in the browsers that matter for the project — rendering, line spacing and feature support.

checks.title: Files pass Fontspector
checks.info: Run the compiled binaries through Fontspector for binary-level QA that this plugin cannot see from the source file.
